title: JSON.parse throws on bad text
why_it_matters: One bad string from storage can crash your whole page.
explanation: JSON.parse throws an error if the text isn't valid JSON, like text someone edited by hand or a failed response. Wrap it in try/catch and return a fallback so your app doesn't crash. JSON needs double quotes around keys and strings.
try_it: Call safeParse with an empty string and see what comes back.
